# PickMyApp

> Honest guides, comparisons and reviews of business software. We check vendor pricing pages, test free plans where possible, take no paid placements, and note the date every price was checked.

## Guides

- [n8n vs Make: Which Is Better for Small Business in 2026?](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/n8n-vs-make-small-business/): Workflow automation compared — pricing per workflow run vs per module action, ease of use, AI features, integrations, and the volume where each tool saves money.
- [Zapier Alternatives: 7 Cheaper Automation Tools Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/zapier-alternatives-cheaper-automation/): Make, n8n, Pabbly Connect, Integrately, Activepieces, Power Automate and IFTTT compared with verified 2026 pricing.
- [Mailchimp vs ConvertKit for Creators](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/mailchimp-vs-convertkit-creators/): Email marketing for creators compared — 2026 pricing, free plan gaps, newsletter and digital-product features, with a verdict for writers, course sellers and indie creators.
- [Cheapest Email Marketing Software for Small Business](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/cheapest-email-marketing-software-small-business/): Real prices at 1K, 5K and 10K subscribers, the best free plans, and what sticker prices hide.
- [HubSpot vs Pipedrive for Small Teams](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/hubspot-vs-pipedrive-small-teams/): CRM comparison for small teams — pricing, pipelines, automation and reporting compared.
- [Best Free CRM for Startups (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-free-crm-startups-2026/): HubSpot, Zoho, Attio, Capsule, EngageBay and Bitrix24 compared — free-tier limits, upgrade costs, and which fits your team.
- [Asana vs Monday vs ClickUp for Small Teams](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/asana-vs-monday-vs-clickup-small-teams/): Project management tools compared on pricing, ease of use and features for small teams.
- [Best Cheap Web Hosting for WordPress (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-cheap-web-hosting-wordpress-2026/): Hostinger, Bluehost, SiteGround and DreamHost compared — real intro and renewal prices plus two-year cost math.
- [Jasper vs Copy.ai for Blog Writing](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/jasper-vs-copy-ai-blog-writing/): AI writing tools compared for blog content — pricing, output quality and workflows.
- [Wix vs Squarespace for Small Business](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/wix-vs-squarespace-small-business/): Website builders compared — pricing, ease of use, templates, ecommerce and SEO, with a verdict for 2026.
